reason: Max Premier Limited has dispatched the composite document for a mandatory unconditional cash offer to acquire all remaining issued shares of Major Holdings.
why_now: The offer document was officially dispatched on November 26, 2026, opening the formal acceptance period for shareholders.
source_headlines: MAJOR HLDGS (01389): JOINT ANNOUNCEMENT DESPATCH OF THE COMPOSITE DOCUMENT RELATING TO THE MANDATORY UNCONDITIONAL CASH OFFER BY KINGSTON SECURITIES LIMITED FOR AND ON BEHALF OF MAX PREMIER LIMITED TO ACQUIRE ALL THE ISSUED SHARES OF MAJOR HOLDINGS LIMITED (OTHER THAN THOSE ALREADY OWNED AND/OR AGREED TO BE ACQUIRED BY MAX PREMIER LIMITED AND PARTIES ACTING IN CONCERT WITH IT)
